MITRA, ET AL Punong Barangay Barangay Aurora, Municipality of Uson Province of Masbate Dear PB Mitra at al. This is with reference to your December 11, 2023 letter to this Department, with enclosures, requesting for guidance on issues concerning the Liga ng mga Barangay (LnB). The first issue was precipitated by the issuance of LnB Memorandum Circular No. 2023-001 and Memorandum Circular 2023-0021 by the Liga ng mga Barangay National Executive Board. These issuances contain the guidelines for the conduct pf the Liga ng mga Barangay elections. Specifically, the MCs require the payment of the of the annual Liga membership dues by 31 August 2023, and failure to comply would mean ineligibility to be voted upon for Liga positions at the provincial, HUC, and ICC levels. However, you stated that in a meeting on 5 July 2023, the Liga ng mga Barangay Uson Chapter set the deadline for the payment of dues on 31 October 2023 to give Liga members ample time to settle the said Liga dues. On the second issue, you are inquiring on the "validity" of Official Receipt No. 0154 dated 4 December 2023, issued as proof of payment of membership dues from 2018-2023 of some members of LnB Uson Chapter. You allege that the payments were received by the LnB Provincial Chapter and not the Municipal Chapter. Moreover, you state that payment made to the LnB Provincial Chapter and the official receipt thereof is "not an Official Receipt coming from the Office of the National President Liga ng mga Barangay sa Pilipinas." Anent the first issue, may we emphasize that the question herein proffered for this Service's legal opinion has been rendered moot and academic by the supervening 1 Revised Guidelines in the Conduct Of the 2024 Liga ng mga Barangay MunicipalÆC/HUC/lCC Elections "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

issuance on December 12, 2023 of LnB Memorandum Circular No. 2023-10 officially recalling Memorandum Circulars Nos. 2023-001 and 2023-062. In this connection, the Department has issued an Advisory dated 14 December 2023 entitled "Liga ng mga Barangay Memorandum Circular No. 2023-010 Recalling Memorandum Citculars Nos. 2023-001 and 2023-002"] The relevant portion of the Advisory is quoted hereunder: Under Memorandum No. 2023-10, the LnB has removed the requirement for payment of membership dues on or before 31 August 2023 as a prerequisite for participation in the chapter elections. Article VI relevantly provides: Article VI 1. All barangays are required to update the full payment of their 2023 Liga Dues and to sign a promissory note FORM 9 to pay their 2024 Liga Dues before January IO, 2024 in order to vote in the Municipal/CC/HUC/CC synchronized elections on December 15, 2023. 2. All Liga Chapters are required to remit the full payment of all 2019 to 2024 Liga Dues, 2024 Liga Dues plus full payment of the 2024 Subscription to the Liga National Office Publication in order for the chapters to vote in the ProvinciabRegional and National Synchronized Elections. The barangay representative in the LnB chapter elections need only update their membership dues, in accordance with the above provision, before the scheduled Liga elections to participate (to vote and be voted upon) in the said chapter elections. As regards the second issue, based on the documents forwarded, we note that Official Receipt No. 0154 was issued by "Liga ng Mga Barangay Province of Masbate, Inc." Considering that the request delves into a determination of whether or not said receipt satisfies the requirements under Section 3, Article Xl of the LnB 2022 Constitution and By-Laws, which are LnB intemal matters, your query would be better addressed by the LnB. Section 507 of the Local Govemment Code specifically states that matters affecting the intemal organization of the leagues of local government units shall be governed by their respective constitution and by-laws, viz: "Section 507. Constitution and By-laws of the Liga and the Leagues. — All other matters not herein otherwise provided for affecting the internal organization of the leagues of local government units shall be govemed by their respective constitution and by-laws which ate hereby made suppletory to the provision of this Chapter: Provided, that said Constitution and By-laws shall always conform to the provisions of the Constitution and existing laws. "

In DILG Legal Opinion No. 2 S. 2016, dated 18 January 2016, we opined therein that: "[Mlatters conceming the implementation of provisions of LnB's Constitution and By-Laws is within the jurisdiction of the National Executive Boam as the body vested with the power and duty to promulgate rules and regulations implementing the same and as the body vested with the powers of control and supervision over all Liga officers and members on matters concerning terms and tenure of office, vacancies and succession and removal and suspension from office. The opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated and our appreciation of the same. Further, this opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, RITY OF THE SECRETARY ANV TOR R. LLAMAS Und ecretary for Extemal, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLNJVRULRALLD0vpr Copy furnished ATTY. ARNALDO E.
